duel.startFailed: Could not create the duel (is the API running?)
duel.animating: Press Space / Enter to skip the animation
duel.discardPrompt: Hand over the limit: tap 1 card to discard it
duel.discardNeedsDrag: Several cards must be discarded: select them, then tap Confirm
duel.pickFusionMonsterHint: Select 1 Fusion Monster, then tap Choose
duel.pickFusionMaterialHint: Select all {count} materials, then tap OK
duel.pickTributeHint: Select monsters to tribute, then tap Confirm
duel.pickDiscardHint: Select cards to discard, then tap Confirm
duel.pickCostHint: Select the cards to pay the activation cost, then tap Confirm
duel.pickTargetHint: Select the target of the effect, then tap Confirm
duel.toastNoZone: You cannot place this card here.
duel.toastCardLocked: This card cannot be used right now.
duel.toastNotAllowed: That action is not allowed right now.
duel.targetPrompt: Choose the target of the effect
duel.pickTriggerHint: Select a target (if needed), then tap Activate, or No
chain.reactionAttack: Opponent attacks — tap a glowing Set card to respond, or Pass
chain.reactionSummon: Opponent summoned — tap a glowing Set card to respond, or Pass
chain.respond: Chain of {count} link(s) (top: {name}) — tap a Set card to respond, or Pass
chain.waitOpponent: Waiting for the opponent to respond…
duel.detailEmpty: Hover / tap a card to see its details
event.deckOut: {player} has no cards left to draw
event.fieldSpellSet: {player} sets a card in the Field Zone
event.fieldSpellReplaced: {player}'s Field Spell {card} is replaced and goes to the Graveyard
event.chainLinkFizzled: {card} of {player} has no effect (its target is gone)
event.chainLinkNegated: {card} of {player} is negated: no effect, sent to the Graveyard
event.summonNegated: {player}'s Summon of {card} is negated: sent to the Graveyard (zone {zone})
event.specialSummonedHand: {player} Special Summons {card} from the hand to zone {zone}
event.specialSummonedGraveyard: {player} Special Summons {card} from the graveyard to zone {zone}
event.fusionMaterialHand: {player} uses {card} from the hand as fusion material (to the Graveyard)
event.fusionMaterialField: {player} uses {card} on the field (zone {zone}) as fusion material (to the Graveyard)
event.fusionMaterialDeck: {player} uses {card} from the Deck as fusion material (to the Graveyard)
ai.tributeSummon: 🤖 AI Tribute Summons {card} in zone {zone}, tributing {tributes}
ai.acceptTriggerTargets: 🤖 AI activates its trigger effect, target: {cards}
error.tooFast: Too many requests, try again in a moment.
error.engine.NO_STATE: The duel is not ready yet.
error.engine.UNHANDLED_ACTION: That action is not supported yet.
error.engine.SURRENDER_DISABLED: Surrender is disabled in this mode.
error.engine.NO_PENDING_PROMPT: There is nothing to answer right now.
error.engine.PROMPT_MISMATCH: That answer does not match the current prompt.
error.engine.INVALID_DISCARD: Wrong number of cards to discard.
error.engine.UNKNOWN_PROMPT_KIND: That kind of prompt is not supported yet.
error.engine.NOT_TURN_PLAYER: It is not your turn yet.
error.engine.WRONG_PHASE: You cannot do that in the current phase.
error.engine.NORMAL_SUMMON_USED: You already used your Summon/Set this turn.
error.engine.CARD_NOT_IN_HAND: That card is no longer in your hand.
error.engine.NO_CARD_RESOLVER: The server is missing card data.
error.engine.CARD_DEFINITION_NOT_FOUND: Could not find the data for that card.
error.engine.NOT_A_MONSTER: That is not a monster card.
error.engine.INVALID_TRIBUTE: The chosen tribute is not valid.
error.engine.ZONE_OCCUPIED: That zone already has a monster.
error.engine.CARD_NOT_ON_FIELD: That card is no longer on the field.
error.engine.MONSTER_FACE_DOWN: The monster is face-down, so you cannot do that.
error.engine.SAME_POSITION: The monster is already in that position.
error.engine.POSITION_ALREADY_CHANGED: This monster already changed position this turn.
error.engine.SUMMONED_THIS_TURN: This monster was just Summoned this turn.
error.engine.ATTACKED_THIS_TURN: This monster already attacked this turn.
error.engine.FIRST_TURN_ATTACK_BANNED: You cannot attack on the first turn.
error.engine.ATTACKER_IN_DEFENSE_POSITIO: A monster in Defense Position cannot attack.
error.engine.JUST_SUMMONED_CANNOT_ATTACK: A monster that was just Summoned cannot attack yet.
error.engine.MUST_TARGET_MONSTER: The opponent still has monsters, pick one to attack.
error.engine.INVALID_TARGET: That attack target is not valid.
error.engine.NOT_A_SPELL_TRAP: That card is not a Spell/Trap.
error.engine.EFFECT_NOT_FOUND: That card has no such effect.
error.engine.NOT_ACTIVATABLE: This effect cannot be activated yet.
error.engine.TRAP_NOT_SET: A Trap must be Set face-down before it can be activated.
error.engine.TRAP_SET_THIS_TURN: This Trap was Set this turn and cannot be activated yet.
error.engine.SPELL_SET_THIS_TURN: This Quick-Play Spell was Set this turn and cannot be activated yet.
error.engine.CONDITION_NOT_MET: The conditions to activate this effect are not met.
error.engine.INVALID_COST: The effect's cost cannot be paid.
error.engine.NO_VALID_TARGET: There is no valid target for this effect.
error.engine.INVALID_EFFECT_TARGET: The chosen target is not valid.
error.engine.NO_CHAIN_WINDOW: No chain is waiting for a response.
error.engine.NOT_PRIORITY_HOLDER: It is not your turn to respond in the chain.
error.engine.CHAIN_WINDOW_OPEN: A chain is waiting to resolve: activate a response or pass first.
error.engine.SPELL_SPEED_TOO_LOW: This card is too slow to be added to the chain.
error.engine.INVALID_TRIGGER_ANSWER: This answer does not fit the trigger effect (choose its targets, or decline an optional one).
error.engine.CONTINUOUS_NOT_ACTIVATABLE: A continuous effect is never activated: it applies by itself while the card is face-up on the field.
error.engine.UNKNOWN_SCRIPT: This effect uses a script the game does not know, so it cannot be activated.
error.engine.NO_FREE_MONSTER_ZONE: There is no empty Monster Zone for this Special Summon.
error.engine.MONSTER_FACE_UP: Only a face-down monster can be Flip Summoned.
error.engine.NO_FREE_SPELL_TRAP_ZONE: There is no empty Spell/Trap Zone for this card.
error.engine.FIELD_ZONE_OCCUPIED: Your Field Zone already holds a card.
error.engine.NOTHING_TO_RESPOND_TO: A Counter Trap can only be activated in response (to an activation, an attack or a Summon).
error.engine.NOTHING_TO_NEGATE: There is nothing for this card to negate right now.
error.engine.INVALID_EXTRA_DECK: The Extra Deck has too many cards.
error.engine.FUSION_NOT_SUMMONABLE: A Fusion Monster can only be Fusion Summoned from the Extra Deck.
error.api.NOT_OWNER: You do not control this duel.
error.api.PLAYER_MISMATCH: That action does not belong to this player.
error.api.VALIDATION_FAILED: The data sent was not valid.
error.api.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired, reload the page.
error.api.AI_LOOP_LIMIT: The server stopped the AI turn because it ran too long.
error.api.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server hit an error, try again later.
error.api.INVALID_VIEWER: You cannot view the duel from this seat.
error.api.INVALID_CONFIG: The duel configuration is not valid.
error.api.UNKNOWN_CARD: The duel contains a card that does not exist.
